copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.description: Ask about how {{hotel}} is running or ask for an action. Nothing runs until you confirm it.
copilot.simulatedHint: Answers without an external model: it understands concrete questions like “how many arrivals today?”.
copilot.disabled: The copilot is switched off for this hotel. Turn it on in Settings › AI.
copilot.emptyText: I look up arrivals, departures, occupancy, availability, balances and rates, and prepare actions you confirm.
copilot.placeholder: Ask a question or request an action…
copilot.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
copilot.fallbackNote: Answered by the simulated assistant: the AI provider isn't available right now.

widget.title: {{hotel}} assistant
widget.subtitle: Instant answers · A real team steps in when you need it
widget.error: We couldn't send your message. Try again.
widget.rateLimited: You sent many messages in a row. Please wait a few minutes.
widget.handoffText: Someone from the hotel will write to you as soon as possible.
widget.name: Name
widget.contactNeeded: Leave us an email or a phone number.
widget.contactSent: Done: we got your details and the team will contact you soon.
widget.privacy: We only use your details to get back to you, under the <privacy>data processing policy</privacy>.

onboarding.title: Guided setup
onboarding.description: Tell us about your hotel and AI proposes room types, rooms, rates and extras. You review everything before it is created.
onboarding.describePlaceholder: E.g.: Boutique hotel in Cartagena with 12 rooms: 8 doubles at 280,000 a night and 4 sea-view suites at 450,000. Breakfast 30,000. Check-in at 3 pm.
onboarding.describeHint: Include how many rooms of each type you have, their prices and what you offer.
onboarding.proposing: Reading your description and putting the proposal together…
onboarding.needInput: Describe your hotel or enter its website address.
onboarding.reviewText: Edit whatever you need. Nothing is created until you press “Create everything”.
onboarding.simulated: Proposal built without an external model (simulated mode): review it carefully.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.roomTypesHint: Each room type is sold separately. Shared dorms are sold by the bed.
onboarding.breakfastHint: Creates the “Breakfast included” plan and the breakfast extra.
onboarding.applying: Creating room types, rooms and rates…
onboarding.doneText: We created {{types}} room types and {{rooms}} rooms with their rates.
onboarding.example: Hotel Brisa Marina, a 3-star boutique hotel in Santa Marta, two blocks from the beach. We have 12 rooms: 8 doubles at 280,000 a night and 4 suites with sea view at 450,000. Breakfast is 30,000 per person and parking 20,000 a night. Check-in at 3 pm, check-out at 11 am. Pool, wifi and air conditioning. No pets.
onboarding.privacy: To build the proposal, the description and the website text are sent to the configured AI provider.
onboarding.noExtras: No extras. Add the services you charge separately (breakfast, parking, transfers).
onboarding.nameRequired: Give every room type a name.
onboarding.priceRequired: Every room type needs a nightly price.
onboarding.extraIncomplete: Fill in the name and price of every extra, or remove it.
onboarding.noRoomTypes: Add at least one room type to create everything.

chatbot.title: Chatbot
chatbot.description: The assistant answers on your website, booking engine and guest portal with these answers.
chatbot.question: Question
chatbot.deleteText: The chatbot will stop using this answer.
chatbot.faqEmptyText: Add what guests ask most: breakfast, parking, pets, hours, how to get there.
chatbot.conversationsEmptyText: Chats from your website will show up here.
chatbot.reasonLow: The assistant didn't know the answer
chatbot.inactiveHint: The chatbot won't use this answer while it's inactive.
chatbot.faqHint: Write the question the way a guest would ask it, and the answer exactly as you want the assistant to give it.
chatbot.required: Write the question and the answer.
chatbot.selectConversation: Choose a conversation to see it.

settings.title: AI
settings.description: Choose the provider, switch AI features on and check their usage.
settings.providerText: If the provider fails or runs out of quota, Housetel answers in simulated mode and warns you with an alert.
settings.noKey: There is no API key: simulated mode is used.
settings.ownKeyHint: Have your own key? Set it up in Integrations.
settings.copilotHint: Side panel to look up operations and prepare actions.
settings.chatbotHint: Chat bubble on your website, booking engine and guest portal.
settings.draftsHint: “AI draft” button in the message inbox.
settings.simulatedText: The simulated assistant answers offline: it understands specific questions but doesn't converse like a model.
settings.providerHint: The model behind the copilot, the chatbot and guided setup.
settings.modeRealHint: Uses the chosen provider; if it fails, the simulated assistant answers and you get an alert.
settings.modeSimulatedHint: Answers without going online or spending quota.
settings.modelHint: Leave it empty to use the platform model.
settings.featuresHint: Switch them off if you don't want them in this hotel.
settings.greetingHint: The first thing a guest sees when opening the chat on your page.
settings.usageHint: Every call to the model, and the ones the simulated assistant answered.
